name: JudgerBench
description: A benchmark encompassing various subjective evaluation tasks covering a wide range of topics, designed to assess the evaluation capabilities of judge models under a unified setting for large language model evaluation.
reputation: A newer benchmark for evaluating judge models on subjective LLM assessment tasks; adoption is emerging rather than yet broadly established.
notes: Introduced alongside CompassJudger-1, an all-in-one judge LLM; benchmark supports diverse subjective evaluation tasks and is publicly released.
